de1: CREATE TABLE t0(c0, c1 TEXT COLLATE NOCASE, c2, c3 TEXT)

SELECT CASE (3.0 = b.c2) WHEN (b.c0 IN (SELECT s.c0 FROM t0 AS s WHERE s.c1 == b.c0)) THEN 1 END AS g, max(quote((b.c1 IS 'abc'))) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY CASE (3.0 = b.c2) WHEN (b.c0 IN (SELECT s.c0 FROM t0 AS s WHERE s.c1 == b.c0)) THEN 1 END ORDER BY 1
SELECT b.c0 IN (SELECT s.c0 FROM t0 AS s WHERE s.c1 == b.c0) AS g, max(quote((b.c1 IS 'abc'))) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT b.c0 IN (SELECT s.c0 FROM t0 AS s) AS g, max(b.c1 IS 'abc') FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT b.c2 AS g, max(b.c1 IS 'abc') FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT b.c2 AS g, max(quote(b.c1 IS 'abc')) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0 AS s WHERE s.c0 = b.c0) AS g, max(b.c1 = 'abc'), sum(b.c1 = 'abc'), count(DISTINCT b.c1), group_concat(DISTINCT b.c1), min(b.c1), max(b.c1) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT (SELECT max(s.c0) FROM t0 AS s WHERE s.c0 = b.c0) AS g, max(b.c1 = 'abc'), sum(b.c1 = 'abc'), count(DISTINCT b.c1) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT b.c2 AS g, sum(b.c1 = 'abc') FILTER (WHERE b.c1 = 'abc'), max(CASE b.c1 WHEN 'abc' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), max(b.c1 IN ('abc', 'q')) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT b.c0 IN (SELECT s.c0 FROM t0 AS s WHERE s.c1 == b.c0) AS g, sum(b.c1 = 'abc') FILTER (WHERE b.c1 = 'abc'), max(CASE b.c1 WHEN 'abc' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), max(b.c1 IN ('abc', 'q')), max(b.c1 BETWEEN 'abc' AND 'abc'), max((b.c1, 1) = ('abc', 1)) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT max(b.c1 = 'abc') FROM t0 AS b
SELECT max(b.c1 = 'abc'), b.c0 IN (SELECT s.c0 FROM t0 AS s WHERE s.c1 == b.c0) FROM t0 AS b
SELECT b.c1 AS g, max(b.c3 = b.c1) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY b.c1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT b.c3 AS g, max(b.c1 = b.c3), max(b.c3 = b.c1) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY b.c3 HAVING max(b.c1 = 'abc') ORDER BY 1
SELECT b.c3 AS g, max(b.c1 = b.c3) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY b.c3, b.c0 IN (SELECT s.c0 FROM t0 AS s WHERE s.c1 == b.c0) ORDER BY max(b.c1 = 'abc'), 1
EXPLAIN SELECT b.c0 IN (SELECT s.c0 FROM t0 AS s WHERE s.c1 == b.c0) AS g, max(quote((b.c1 IS 'abc'))) FROM t0 AS b GROUP BY 1
